scope: Development evaluation; no application behavior changes.
measurement_design: One isolated session per question; no production writes or permanent training captures.
Normal application behavior, including working direct shortcuts, is preserved.
Model metrics include routing, planning, retries and answer composition; missing token usage remains unknown.
Saved-result questions use actual validated native results created before the timed turn.
Selected-card payloads are sent unchanged; rejected request contracts count as failures.
Every completed case is checkpointed; automatic success requires the labelled lane, operation and behavior checks.

approval.scope: Prepared isolated local Qwen baseline with the existing server credential and copied Yelp/demo graphs.

findings.finding: All eight saved-result views pass without planning or a new calculation.
All eight missing-information cases and all four unsupported calculations select the expected lane.
Seven of eight saved-result explanations meet the full label; one returns the correct vertex IDs instead of the requested account names.
findings.source: analytics._labels reads only top-level label; the demo supplies attributes.name.

findings.finding: Conceptual replies, metadata descriptions, lightweight lookups and two-option proposals do not have their requested lanes yet.
All four explicit picked-card payloads are rejected by the current request schema before a model call.

The most-outgoing-connections lookup returns the correct native top row for Ada but duplicates the same aggregation twice. The capped outputs and different operation fail the strict baseline criteria; chat facts omit the top account.
The biclique calculation matches all 33 independent expected bicliques. Directed input requests confirmation, and missing sides stop before planning.

interpretation.success_definition: Expected lane, accepted operation set, and the frozen behavior checks all match. This is not an overall numerical-accuracy percentage.
interpretation.authorship: Assistant-authored development regression labels, frozen before model use; no human annotation or held-out evaluation claim.
interpretation.timings: One serial live run against the existing local Qwen server; measured turn time includes routing, planning, product retries, native execution and answer composition. Fixture setup is excluded.
interpretation.zero_latency_cases: Four rejected selected-card payloads took less than the report millisecond precision and made no model calls.
interpretation.alternative_valid_computations: The fixed expected operation and completeness criteria can reject a numerically correct alternative, as the preserved top-account aggregation illustrates.
interpretation.verification_scope: Thirteen completed calculation cases passed their independent frozen output checks. Other labels test routing, required questions, display actions, saved facts or request-contract behavior.

remaining_goal_scope: Phases 2–5 remain. Phase 1 is complete; stop and report before eligibility and lane implementation.

reproduction.environment: Use the development CPU runtime and analytics interpreter plus the existing local model endpoint credential. The runner creates an isolated temporary store and refuses to overwrite a report.
